proposals.name: Retro-Computing Restoration & Customization
proposals.buyer_persona: Retro-tech collectors and hobbyists who restore Amiga, Atari, Commodore, and early Macintosh computers and want precise replacement components or customized aesthetic decals.
product_angles: 3D-printable replacement drive bezels, custom keycap adapters, and case feet (Cults3D)
SVG vector decal sheets for restoration of case logos and custom keyboard layouts (Etsy)
Vintage-style schematic artwork and technical blueprint posters (Redbubble)
proposals.first_test_product: 3D-printable replacement drive latch and custom badge set for the Amiga 500

proposals.name: Solo Print-and-Play (PnP) RPGs & Board Games
proposals.buyer_persona: Solo gamers looking for print-at-home tabletop RPG experiences, tracking journals, and minimalistic card/dice layout sheets.
product_angles: Solo RPG journaling templates and campaign tracker logs (KDP/PDF)
Printable pocket-sized hex-crawl maps and modular dungeon card decks (Etsy/PDF)
Minimalistic token designs and counters ready for laser cutting or 3D printing (Cults3D/Etsy)
proposals.first_test_product: Solo RPG Campaign Logbook & Hex-Grid Journal for fantasy adventurers

proposals.name: HEMA (Historical European Martial Arts)
proposals.buyer_persona: Practitioners of historical fencing, longsword combat, and medieval martial arts looking for training logs, rulebooks, and niche-specific gear design.
product_angles: HEMA Training Logbook tracking sparring metrics, techniques, and bouts (KDP)
Medieval treatise-style stylized vector graphics for gear customization (Etsy/Redbubble)
proposals.first_test_product: The Longsword Fencer's Codex: A structured 12-week training log

proposals.name: Microscopy & Tardigrade Admirers
proposals.buyer_persona: Science teachers, amateur biologists, and micro-photography enthusiasts obsessed with microscopic life (tardigrades, rotifers, diatoms).
product_angles: Micro-world and Tardigrade line-art coloring book (KDP)
Vintage scientific botany/microbiology style vector stickers (Redbubble)
Diatom arrangement geometric SVG pattern packs (Etsy)
proposals.first_test_product: The Microscopic Kingdom: Tardigrades and Protozoa Coloring Book

proposals.name: Geotechnical Engineers & Soil Mechanics
proposals.buyer_persona: Civil engineers, geologists, and geotechnical professionals looking for niche humor, field logbooks, and office mugs.
product_angles: Geotechnical Engineer Field Book with built-in reference charts/formulas (KDP)
Mohr's Circle, shear strength, and 'soil mechanics' inside-joke apparel (Redbubble)
Unified Soil Classification System (USCS) quick-reference vector templates (Etsy)
proposals.first_test_product: Geotechnical Field Notebook & Soil Classification Quick-Reference Guide

proposals.name: French Micro-Museums & Regional Heritage Sites
proposals.buyer_persona: Curators of local French historical monuments, small regional museums, and heritage protection associations seeking affordable souvenir merchandise.
product_angles: Customizable regional history coloring books depicting specific local monuments (KDP/Direct B2B)
3D-printable architectural replicas of local castles/chateaux for souvenir shops (Cults3D/B2B)
Vector-based historical postcard templates highlighting regional legends (Etsy/Direct B2B)
proposals.first_test_product: Customizable 'Coloriage Patrimoine' template pack for French medieval ruins
